messages:
Jordan (Sales): Quick context — Acera Corp signed MSA yesterday. Key contacts: Maya (CTO), Raj (SRE). They requested private VPC + Okta SSO and reserved dedicated capacity starting ~4 weeks out. Expected baseline: ~4M tokens/month, spikes to ~6M. Renewal window in 11 months; procurement timeline looks slow so flagging potential renewal risk if PO slips beyond 60 days. Attached: eval summary and sample prompts (link). Ask: hand to CS to own kickoff + to Eng/Support for SSO/VPC precheck and runbook. Proposed owners: Michelle (CS) lead, Sam (Eng) SSO/VPC precheck, Kevin (Support) runbook. Can you ack and confirm owners + timeline?

Michelle (CS): Ack — I’ll take this as CS lead. I’ll schedule a 30m kickoff with Maya/RAJ for technical intake. Can someone drop the eval prompts and a short list of priority flows (happy path + error cases)? Also need billing contact + PO ETA.

Jordan (Sales): Dropped prompts here: https://drive.redwood/example-acera-prompts. Model they plan to run: redwood/open-l7k-quant (7B quantized). Peak concurrency estimate: 50rps. Billing contact is Tara (Finance) — she’s looped. PO expected ~3 weeks but flagged procurement review could add time.

Sam (Eng): I can take the SSO/VPC precheck. ETA: 5 business days for initial review. I need: 1) test subnet details for peering 2) firewall egress rules 3) terraform state access or a contact who owns infra. Also confirm which GPU flavor they want for Dedicated. Canary rollout recommended (10% first week).

Kevin (Support): I’ll own the support/runbook doc. Initial runbook checklist I'll draft includes token limits, throttling behavior, error fallbacks, monitoring alerts and escalation contacts. Quick snippet I’ll start with:
```
alerts:
  - latency_p95 > 500ms
  - error_rate > 1%
fallback: redwood/hosted-compat-model
rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
```
Will share first draft by Monday.

ops-bot: Calendar event created for kickoff: Tue 10:00am PST — "Acera technical kickoff" (invitees: Jordan, Michelle, Sam, Kevin, Maya).

Michelle (CS): Good. I’m creating a shared kickoff doc with an "owners & due dates" table. Proposing action items + deadlines: 1) Jordan — upload eval data + confirm PO ETA (due EOD Thu) 2) Sam — SSO/VPC precheck (initial findings by Fri) 3) Kevin — draft runbook (by Mon) 4) Michelle — schedule and run kickoff + capture requirements (by Tue).

Tara (Finance): Confirmed I’ll prioritize PO with procurement; I expect contractual review to finish within 3 weeks but will flag earlier if delayed. Also requested SOC2 report & additional SLA language — adding to risk notes.

Jordan (Sales): Noted. I also added model artifact size and quantization notes to the doc. Concurrency/throughput requirements in the doc too.

Sam (Eng): If procurement requires private deployment checklist, we’ll need approximate model memory footprint and estimated GPU hours. Jordan — can you confirm the model checkpoint size?

Jordan (Sales): Checkpoint ~9GB after quantization. I added that to the drive doc.

Michelle (CS): Summary / next steps (I’ll post this into the kickoff doc):
- Owners: Michelle (CS) lead, Sam (Eng) precheck, Kevin (Support) runbook, Jordan (Sales) data + prompts, Tara (Finance) PO.
- Timeline: initial precheck & runbook in 5 business days; kickoff scheduled Tue 10am PST.
- Risks: procurement review / SOC2 & SLA asks -> Renewal risk set to "monitor"; escalate to AM/RevOps if PO not in by +60 days.
- Ask for CS: please collect any product-specific eval failure cases during kickoff so we can tie to quality monitors.

Kevin (Support): Adding alerts and runbook link to the shared doc now. Will include escalation contact matrix and sample troubleshooting commands.

Michelle (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — I’ll ping #sales if we don’t have the PO ETA update in 3 business days. Closing loop for now, will update thread after kickoff and attach the finalized runbook.
